name: Neural.love Video Enhancer
summary: Neural.love offers AI-powered upscaling, colorization, and restoration for old or damaged video footage, making your archives shine.
description: Neural.love offers AI-powered upscaling, colorization, and restoration for old or damaged video footage, making your archives shine. The video enhancer page is titled AI Video Enhancer. It lists 4K upscaling, an FPS boost, colorization, and facial restoration. The old /video-enhancer path is not a route of the site and returns 404 after the app loads.

pricing.label: Freemium
pricing.note: Price label carried over from the previous catalog and not rechecked.

howToUse.title: Sign up
howToUse.description: Open the AI Video Enhancer and sign up.

howToUse.title: Upload a video
howToUse.description: Upload a file. The page lists MOV, MP4, MKV, AVI, and more.

howToUse.title: Choose enhancements
howToUse.description: The page offers 4K upscaling, an FPS boost, colorization, and facial restoration.

howToUse.title: Preview
howToUse.description: Preview the result before processing the full file.

howToUse.title: Process in the cloud
howToUse.description: The page says the video is processed in the cloud.

howToUse.title: Download
howToUse.description: Download the result as MP4 (H264) or MOV (ProRes 422).

statusNote: https://neural.love/video-enhancer is not a current route (404 after the app loads). The video enhancer is https://neural.love/video.
